description: This file contains unit tests for gyp-mode in Emacs Lisp, including functions to fontify GYP files, compare fontification results against golden samples, and manage golden sample files.

methods.name: fontify
methods.description: Reads a filename, applies gyp-mode, fontifies the buffer, and returns the string with fontified contents.

methods.name: read-golden-sample
methods.description: Reads and returns the pre-fontified golden sample for comparison.

methods.name: equivalent-face
methods.description: Normalizes certain text faces for comparison purposes.

methods.name: text-face-properties
methods.description: Extracts text properties for face comparison.

methods.name: test-golden-samples
methods.description: Unit test that compares fontification results against golden samples to ensure accuracy.

methods.name: create-golden-sample
methods.description: Creates and saves a golden sample from a fontified version of a file.

methods.name: create-golden-samples
methods.description: Recreates all golden samples for the test data set.
